_about: Operational metrics from the production multi-agent debate system over its first ~2 months in production (2026-04-08 onward).

stages.name: Critic
stages.structure: batches of 8, parallel, verdicts in {approve, revise, reject}

stages.name: Revisor
stages.structure: single batched LLM call across every revise verdict

stages.name: Backfill
stages.structure: 2 extra slots (diverse, defensive) when approved < target_approved

stages.name: Ranker
stages.structure: single LLM call selecting top-k for diversity / relevance / simplicity when approved > max_approved

caveats: Materialisation rate (36.9%) is the agent-architecture-attributable selectivity: it measures how often a raw LLM proposal survives Critic review, Revisor revision, and the auto-validation gate.
The LLM debate is the upstream stage; further stages of the production pipeline process its output before the portfolio metrics are realised.
